shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge, climb animations, wall risers, research gating, PS + TO support, global click-through. W12-15 SHIPPED; §94 PUBLISHED. W18: §98 four-pass code audit + GL/MapPreview compat REPAIRED AND FIELD-VERIFIED (#508) — the Map Preview bridge had been 100% dead for versions; previews now match the colony.
body:
**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52-§86 records (index unchanged); **§87 GLOBAL click-through (+§87.b, VERIFIED w17)**; **§88 CE manned weapons (QUEUED)**; **§89 stall (14 sightings; instrumentation ask UNANSWERED)**; §90 disembark tile; §91 PERF PASS; §92 BELOW-VIEW FOG GATE; §93 w15 field reports; **§94 PLANNER (PUBLISHED user-solo; docs debt)**; **§95 VISUAL-FX RENDER-LEVEL (A+B, E+E2 FIELD-VERIFIED; §95.j seam fix STILL UNTESTED)**; **§96 WATER (mechanism CONFIRMED; ⚠ PERMANENT FIX NOT IMPLEMENTED)**; **§97 WORKSHOP TO REPORT (PARKED)**; **§98 W18 AUDIT + GL/MAPPREVIEW REPAIR (FIELD-VERIFIED #508)**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE: `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). READ THE V1 FILE FIRST when a V2 feature has an ancestor. `read` refuses that path; `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it.

# 0. START HERE — WINDOW 18

**WINDOW 17 IN ONE PARAGRAPH (closed 2026-08-31).** §95 render-level support for visual-FX mods: Tiers A+B (fleck seam, Sun&Moon/[LBY]云 sky bridges, SimpleFX gates) FIELD-VERIFIED; Tier E→E2 (position-blind draws translated at `Graphics.Internal_DrawMesh`) FIELD-VERIFIED; §96 water diagnosed to square `_MapSize` over two lab runs; §97 split into §87.b (fixed, VERIFIED) and a TO half not reproduced (parked). At close, run #497 surfaced §95.j (static-fleck seam silently failed on `FleckSystemStatic`) and the ABWaterLab attribute gap — both fixed, **both STILL UNTESTED**.

**WINDOW 18 SO FAR.** User-directed audit + optimization pass (§98). Four mechanical passes over 50,336 lines found the codebase in good shape and produced exact findings; all approved C-items are in. Then GL + Map Preview were read against the INSTALLED 1.6 binaries and **the headline discovery was that the entire Map Preview bridge had been dead for an unknown number of versions** — `Resolve()` threw on its second statement and skipped the step that installs everything. Repaired, and the whole landform chain (§56n/§56m/§56r/§56q) is now **FIELD-VERIFIED at run #508**: preview and colony agree, confirmed both numerically (anchor water == surface water exactly, in all three passes) and visually (user screenshots, `GL_CoastCorner`).

**⚠⚠ WINDOW 18 NEXT MOVES, IN ORDER:**
1. **TEST THE TWO STILL-UNTESTED w17 ITEMS** — never covered by any w18 run: §95.j static-fleck seam (pin horseshoes on the surface, watch from the sky band, expect mirrored horseshoes; grep "fleck mirror seated on N", NO "could not seat") and the ABWaterLab `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]` fix.
2. **§96.d PERMANENT WATER FIX — STILL NOT IMPLEMENTED.** Mechanism lab-proven (square `_MapSize`); players still have vertical water. Needs the round-2 delivery detail (material-local if HasProperty > 0 and the mats toggle worked, else banded-only global in a permanent `SetTextures` postfix) — ask, or re-run the lab (2 min).
3. **THE PUBLISH PASS** (checklist §31) — now carries §94 docs debt + §95 + §87.b + §96 + **§98**. UPDATE_NOTES rewrite; commit AND PUSH (nothing since `f2939e1`); decompile-prove Release; About/Preview = user's copy; glyph ruling; **subscribe-to-own-item ask**. ⚠ §98's player-facing line for the notes: "map previews now match the colony you generate" — that bridge was dead for everyone, so it is the most user-visible fix in the release.
4. **⚠ INSTRUMENTATION POLICY DECISION (ask the user):** the w18 root cause hid for versions behind `ABLog.Dev`, which is `verboseLogging`-gated and OFF by default (rule 64 exactly). Proposal: promote the ONE-LINE compat resolve summary per bridge to an always-on `Log.Message`. Not yet done — rule 5.
5. **§97 TO report** — parked on reporter questionnaire.
6. Standing queue: E3 (§95.i), §88 CE (queued four windows), §89 (instrumentation ruling FIRST — asked w15+w16, unanswered).

**✅ SHIPPED/LIVE:** w12-15 on Workshop 3776015553 (w15 `f2939e1`); §94 published user-solo. **⚠ LOCAL GIT: nothing pushed since `f2939e1`; w17 AND w18 work is in autosaves only.** THE WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD — NORMAL (`#if DEBUG` is the off switch; DECOMPILE TO PROVE at publish, rule 17/64).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked — scans COMPAT ONLY; V1 exempt. (2) Building art = USER. (3) About description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N choices. (5) NO NEW INSTRUMENTATION WITHOUT ASKING. (6) A user deferral is a ruling.

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (standing):** §91.c DORMANT; §90 elevator-fallback + walled-front-tile; §85 flipped up-link approachCells; §62.N, §70; §62.M, §66c, §66e. **⚠ VERIFIED-WITH-CAVEAT:** §94.g FLIP (never log-captured). **⚠ BUILT-UNTESTED:** §95.j seam fix + ABWaterLab attribute (w17, and w18 never covered them); §56p biome-transition suppression (resolved FOUND, never visually verified); §98's C-items (in, exercised incidentally, no defects seen). **✅ FIELD-VERIFIED W18 (#508):** §56q, §56n, §56m, §56r, the MapPreviewCompat resolver repair.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE RULES (headline forms; unabridged pre-w17 revs):** 1 CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2 NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3 FLOOD CELLS. 4 COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/STACKS. 5 A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP. 7 THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 A REPAIR PASS MUST NOT RE-CREATE DELIBERATE REMOVALS. 9 SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 A CELL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN ACTION. 12 A FOREIGN SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT (**§56r is its purest form yet: we corrected the INPUTS GL reads rather than GL**). 13 NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 ASK WHAT IS AT THE DESTINATION. 15 ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST (**§56r's `AssertNoneOutstanding`**). 16 COUNT THE WRITE PATHS. 17 A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX + decompile the binary (**w18 lived it three times: the `MaxStackedZ` "bug" evaporated on arithmetic; the field rename was only provable against the installed dll; and screenshots from a still-running session nearly passed as a fix — CHECK THE LOG TIMESTAMP AGAINST THE BUILD TIMESTAMP**). 18 NEVER EXONERATE ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 `TicksGame` RESTARTS. 20 EARLIER WORK TURNS ON EVERY READINESS GATE. 21 THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL. 22 A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN. 23 AUDIT THE WEIGHTING. 24 CLAMP THE TARGET TOO. 25 A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS TOO LATE. 26 PASS THE RENDERER'S GATE. 27 SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 A FICTION FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS FACT TO THE REST. 29 REPORT OUTCOMES. 30 A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN. 31 MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE. 32 A TICK CARRIES SERVICES. 33 A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO + COUNT PER-CLASS FAILURES. 34 INVISIBLE = ABSENT FROM EVERY LAYER. 35 A CLONED DEF IS IN NO LOOKUPS. 36 RUN VANILLA'S PREDICATE. 37 NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT — LAB OVER THEORY (**w18: every gate passed on paper and the bug was elsewhere; one log line ended it**). 38 OWN THE DRAW — AT THE FUNNEL. 39 LAST WRITE ≠ SETTLED TARGET. 40 A TRIPWIRE BEFORE THE OBSERVER IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 AN UNSET FIELD IS AN UNSHIPPED FEATURE. 42 READ-DIRECTION IS THE THING'S PROPERTY. 43 DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION. 44 A WHOLE OFFSET ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 TRAVEL ≠ ELEVATION. 46 SCALE × ROTATION = SHEAR. 47 A CACHED CURSOR CELL IS A COORDINATE ASSUMPTION. 48 A WRITE READ BACK BY ITS CALLER IS NOT A WRITE. 49 A TEST FOR A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT B. 50 TWO OWN PATCHES CANCEL SILENTLY. 51 A FACTORY CONSUMED ITS INPUT. 52 AN OVERLAY ASKS THE CLICK'S QUESTION, READ-ONLY. 53 A PREDICATE IS CLOSED OVER ITS CALLER'S ARGS. 54 SEARCH THE CAPABILITY. 55 FALLBACK JOBS COUNT. 56 RANK-VS-FILTER FINDS THE BLIND SPOT. 57 TWO "WHICH SIDE" ANSWERS = ONE WRONG. 58 ART ≠ DEF. 59 MEASURE size FROM THE DRAWING. 60 MEASURE THE PIXELS. 61 A COLOURED GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT. 62 FINISHED-ANSWER TABLES ROT — **and so do FOREIGN FIELD NAMES (`MapSizeOverride` → `GameInitMapSizeOverride`)**. 63 MEASURE PATIENCE FROM ITS EVENT. 64 OFF-BY-DEFAULT DIAGNOSTICS DON'T EXIST — **w18's headline scar: a dead bridge hid for versions behind one `verboseLogging` line**. 65 THE FOURTH FAILURE IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT. 66 A DESTINATION DOESN'T CONSTRAIN ENTRY SIDE. 67 ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER. 68 TWICE ON ONE DEF = THE DEF'S RULE. 69 SUSPENDING A DRIVER INHERITS ITS REQUESTS. 70 OPT-IN AT N CONSUMERS = WRONG LAYER. 71 "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK. 72 A NAMED-BUILDING DESTINATION OUTLIVES CORRECTIONS. 73 A PROBE COMPUTING ITS OWN ANSWER ISN'T READING. 74 NAME THE DENOMINATOR. 75 CROSS-BAND LENGTH PRICES NORTH AS UP. 76 VERIFY THE WINNER.
**⚠ 77 (w18) A REVERTED FIX MAY HAVE BEEN CORRECT ARITHMETIC ON A POISONED INPUT.** Before re-proposing something a banner says was "tried and reverted", find the PRECONDITION that made it wrong and ask whether it still holds. §56m's mask was reverted because GL painted the destination; §56n stopped the painting, so the mask became right. They are ONE change.
**⚠ 78 (w18) ONE `try` AROUND N LOOKUPS MAKES N FEATURES ONE FEATURE.** A compat resolver that catches once aborts at the FIRST dead member and silently skips every install after it. Isolate each lookup; put the step that actually installs the integration LAST and unconditional. A class comment promising independence is worth nothing if the resolver does not deliver it.
**⚠ 79 (w18) A HOST THAT SKIPS GENSTEPS GIVES ITS GUESTS DIFFERENT FACTS.** Map Preview runs 6 gensteps, so `RocksFromGrid` never runs and its anchor rows are edifice-free. Any generation-time patch whose OUTPUT depends on map state must ask whether that state exists in the preview too, or preview and colony diverge for reasons unrelated to size.

# 98. W18 AUDIT + GL / MAP PREVIEW REPAIR — **FIELD-VERIFIED #508**

**98.a THE AUDIT (four mechanical passes; harness in `%TEMP%/abscan/`).** 135 files / 50,336 lines / 357 types / 1,236 methods / 115 attributed + 18 manual patches. **12 dead methods** (verified twice); **28 clone pairs, largest 10 logic lines**; **16 cache-hostile x-outer/z-inner loops**; **54 silent catches of 303**; **5 targets patched by 2+ of our own classes**. CLEAN: zero TODO/FIXME/HACK, no leaking statics, both hottest patches already optimal. ⚠ Pass-3 call-graph reachability OVER-REPORTS: `ABCameraBounds.Summary` is button-triggered and its dialog is dev-only — always confirm the caller before optimising.

**98.b THE ROOT CAUSE THAT DWARFED THE REST.** `AccessTools.Method(sizeUtilType, "DetermineMapSize")` throws AmbiguousMatchException on the shipped 1.6 assembly (both overloads survive there despite the `#if` in source). It was the SECOND statement inside `Resolve()`'s single try, so the whole method aborted: MaxMapSize never raised, no size hook installed, crop/window/reroll patches all unarmed. **The Map Preview bridge had been 100% dead for an unknown number of versions**, reporting it only through one `verboseLogging`-gated line (rule 64). Fixes: `FindDetermineMapSize()` selects by SHAPE (returns IntVec2, last param MapParent, longest wins, never throws) and `Resolve()` is now per-step isolated with `RaiseSizeCaps` LAST and unconditional (rule 78).

**98.c THE LANDFORM CHAIN — FOUR PARTS, ALL REQUIRED.** Genstep order is `ElevationFertility(10) → MutatorPostElevationFertility(20) → RocksFromGrid(200) → Terrain(210) → MutatorPostTerrain(220)`.
- **§56q SIZE** — register a `MapSizeTransform` (their supported 1.6 hook, composes with VEF's) instead of postfixing `DetermineMapSize`; the postfix is now a rule-33 fallback, disarmed when the transform registers.
- **§56n POLLUTION** — prefix clamps `ApplyBuffered`'s `mapSize.z` to the anchor height on BOTH closed generics (`<float>`, `<TerrainDef>`; both or neither, else the feature disables and warns). Stops GL painting the surface band with out-of-domain output AND removes ~4x wasted evaluation.
- **§56m IMPORT** — per-cell write mask restores the authored-cell terrain lift, legal ONLY because §56n removed the pollution (rule 77).
- **§56r DECISION CONTEXT** (`ABGLContextBorrow`, own file) — GL's `TerrainAt` reads four map-space inputs (BiomeAt, GetEdifice, Fertility, Caves) at the ANCHOR rows, so a coastline stopped wherever BASEMENT rock was. Measured #507: anchor 6,092 edifices vs surface 4,929; GL authored 1,893 cells where a preview authored 3,619. The borrow lends the surface band's four inputs to the anchor rows for GL's method body only. Released at the TOP of the postfix (before the lift, which writes through `SetTerrain`); only anchor rows are written, surface is read-only; half-taken unwinds; `AssertNoneOutstanding` shouts on a leak.

**98.d THE VERIFICATION (#508, `GL_CoastCorner`, 126×896).** `context=SURFACE(15876 cells borrowed)` on all three passes; **anchor water == surface water EXACTLY** (7608/7608, 6548/6548, 5513/5513 — #507 had 1585 vs 1576); authored cells 1,893 → **7,159**; no borrow failure, no leak, no warning. ⚠ THE RESTORE IS SELF-VERIFYING: the post-pass census shows anchor edifice=2,526 vs surface=3,059 — if the borrow had leaked they would be equal. User screenshots confirm the coastline, rock masses and the notched peninsula all line up. ⚠ Preview still authors MORE than the colony and that is CORRECT (rule 79): previews have no rock at all, and the cells GL declines sit under stone the preview paints anyway (`RocksFromGrid` spawns at Elevation > 0.7; MapPreview paints stone at >= 0.7 — they agree by construction).

**98.e DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED (do not "fix" these).** **C4 `CompMemo`** — readonly fields are the lock-free publish contract (§91); mutable statics would open a torn read on the preview thread, and it allocates once per MAP SWITCH. **riverFlowMap lift loop** — GL indexes `(x * Size.z + z) * 2`, X-MAJOR, so x-outer is already sequential there. **`SectionLayer_ABBelowSnow` L110** — order must match `MakeBaseGeometry`'s nine-vertices-per-cell contract. **Snow L267** — already sequential. **Shadows L156 / V2Water L260** — 289-cell and 17×17 walks on mesh rebuild; no measurable gain against churn risk. **11 remaining dead methods** — pending a keep/delete ruling; two are documented as deliberately kept.

**98.f WHAT ELSE SHIPPED.** §56p `Patch_GL_ABBiomeTransitionScope` (suppresses `PostProcessBiomeGrid`'s cross-seam flood fill on banded maps; resolved FOUND, not visually verified). `ABBandedGeneration.RealGenerationInFlight` — new gate distinguishing "the real colony" from "what is this map's layout"; `ABGenProfile` now uses it, because `TryPendingSurfaceRect` answers TRUE for previews BY DESIGN and the profiler was arming on Map Preview's background thread. 9 GL transplant loops reordered z-outer/x-inner. `PlaceWorker_ABLinkApproach.DrawGhost` list reuse. `ABMapSizeLimit.ChooserStrings` memo (12 `Translate()` + 4 `N0` per frame → rebuilt on change only, keyed on `LanguageDatabase.activeLanguage`).

**98.g TEMPORARY DIAGNOSTICS STILL IN THE BUILD** (all `ABLog.Dev`, off for players): `Map Preview transform CALLED`, `FALLBACK postfix fired`, `inferred layout ACCEPTED/DECLINED` (one-shot per map), `DetermineMapSize -> N-arg overload`, `context=SURFACE(N cells borrowed)`. Keep or prune at publish — they are cheap and they are exactly what would have caught 98.b years earlier.

**98.h KNOWN REMAINING GAP.** The context borrow covers the TERRAIN pass only. The ELEVATION pass (`GeneratePostElevationFertility`) gates its caves module on `elevation[c] > 0.7f`, read at anchor rows; for a landform that authors elevation (Lone Mountain, Cirque) that gate reads basement values. Not observed yet — `GL_Coast`/`GL_CoastCorner` author NO elevation ("grids authored by GL: NONE" in every w18 run). ⚠ Snapshot ordering is the trap if implemented: the anchor snapshot must be taken AFTER borrowing, or the borrow itself reads as "GL authored".
